portInfo.description: Port of Antwerp-Bruges manages the combined Antwerp and Bruges/Zeebrugge port system. The authority’s cited cruise arrivals page is Zeebrugge-specific. SeaDays therefore does not copy Zeebrugge terminal metrics into this Antwerp city guide. City Scheldt berth names, LOA, draught and door pins remain unverified pending a city-berth primary.

thingsToDo.intro: Pick one neighbourhood or excursion scale and keep time for the gangway queue on the way back.
topThings: Cathedral / Grote Markt area — ~90 min (hours not verified).
thingsToDo.shortCall: Stay near the port area and keep a generous buffer before all-aboard.
thingsToDo.standardCall: Combine a central walk, one attraction, and lunch if times allow—start back well before all-aboard.
thingsToDo.longerCall: A second stop or coach outing is realistic only with confirmed transport and an eight-hour or longer window.
thingsToDo.practicalTip: Read the ticket: Antwerp vs Zeebrugge are different landings under one authority.

gettingThere.fromTerminal: Antwerp city Scheldt cruise landing (unverified berth id) — Antwerp, Belgium
gettingThere.distanceToCity: If alongside in the city centre, expect a short walk to the historic core — minutes unverified. If your ticket says Zeebrugge, use the Zeebrugge guide instead.
